en: A colored postcard-style image showing a large medieval clock tower with wooden upper structures and a steep tiled roof, standing on a hill above a town. Two large clock faces with Roman numerals are visible on the stone tower. In the foreground are trees and a path; in the background lies a panoramic view of the town and surrounding hills under a blue sky. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Gras – Uhrturm."
